stages.count_source: Fig. 1 arrow "55723"; text p3 (17419 with elastic tensors)
stages.name: sources
stages.verbatim_span: Currently, there are electronic DOS database available for 55723 materials and elastic tensors for 17419 materials (using the v08.18.2021 version of JARVIS-DFT database at the time of writing).

rule_gap.what: the database field holding theta_D is not named; materials without an elastic tensor cannot pass
rule_gap.frozen_reading: theta_D recomputed from JARVIS-DFT elastic data with eq. 2 in C2 (parent rebuild) and compared to any deposited Debye field

stages.name: debye
stages.observable: Debye temperature from the finite-difference elastic tensor
stages.method: theta_D from sound velocity of the elastic tensor (eq. 2)
stages.verbatim_span: Out of 17419 materials, we find 5618 of them with θD greater than 300 K.

rule_gap.frozen_reading: not recomputed unless jarvis-tools exposes the DOS at E_F; else the stage is template only

stages.name: dos_fermi
stages.observable: electronic DOS at the Fermi level per valence electron
stages.method: JARVIS-DFT DOS normalised by the total number of valence electrons
stages.verbatim_span: Furthermore, selecting materials with electronic DOS at the Fermi level greater than 1 states/eV/Nelect, we find 1736 materials.

rule_gap.what: "As of now" means 1058 may be a subset of the materials passing J1-J3; the cell basis (primitive or conventional) is unstated
rule_gap.frozen_reading: atoms as deposited (sites in the JARVIS atoms record) <= 5; parent materials passing J1-J3 but absent from the 1058 are logged as "not run", never as rejects

stages.count_source: text p8 and Fig. 1 "1058" (the atoms gate is not drawn in Fig. 1)
stages.name: natoms
stages.observable: number of atoms in the cell
stages.verbatim_span: Next, we apply the J-Scr workflow on materials with number of atoms less than equal to 5, θD >300K and N (0) >1 as discussed in the previous section. As of now, we have applied J-Scr to 1058 materials.

stages.name: epc
stages.method: DFT-PT EPC, Quantum ESPRESSO, GBRV pseudopotentials, JARVIS-converged k-grid, q-grid >= 2x2x2, broadening 0.05 Ry, interpolated (Gaussian) method; structures fully relaxed with QE settings
stages.verbatim_span: During this step, we use the same k-points grid found during the JARVIS-DFT total energy convergence, as well as a q-point grid of at least 2 × 2 × 2 with a broadening of 0.05 Rydberg (≈ 0.68 eV).

rule_gap.what: abstract and Fig. 1 say ">= 5 K", Sec 2.1 says "> 5 K"
rule_gap.frozen_reading: >= 5 K; items with Tc within rounding of 5 K (|Tc - 5| < 0.05 K at the deposit precision, widened to the second-route tolerance in C2) reported apart

stages.name: tc
stages.verbatim_span: we identify 105 dynamically stable materials with transition temperatures, TC ≥ 5 K. ... only 626 of them are dynamically stable (i.e. no imaginary phonon modes) and 105 of them have TC >5 K

rule_gap.what: tolerance for "imaginary" unstated; gate order differs between Fig. 1 (Tc then stability: 1058 -> 283 -> 105) and the text (626 stable of 1058, 105 of those with Tc)
rule_gap.frozen_reading: stability = the deposited "stability" field; a material failing BOTH J5 and J6 has an order-dependent eliminating gate and is never a Fate key (restrictive reading); Fate keys only materials failing exactly one

stages.name: dynamic_stability
stages.verbatim_span: As of now, we have applied J-Scr to 1058 materials. Out of these, only 626 of them are dynamically stable (i.e. no imaginary phonon modes)

derived_laws.name: omega_log
derived_laws.law: omega_log = exp[(2/lambda) int dw alpha2F(w)/w ln w] (eq. 8)

derived_laws.name: mcmillan_allen_dynes
derived_laws.span: the TC from the McMillan-Allen-Dynes formula, using µ∗ = 0.09, from our J-Scr workflow has an excellent agreement
derived_laws.note: eq. 7 has no f1 f2 factors: allen_dynes.tc_mcmillan_ad (not the full Allen-Dynes form)

derived_laws.name: debye
derived_laws.law: theta_D = h/kB (3 n NA rho / (4 pi M))^(1/3) v_m (eq. 2)

cost_units.definition: named default (D3): EPC cost per material = 3 x n_atoms (phonon modes per q-point) from the span "the number of modes to calculate at each q-point increases with the number of atoms in the primitive cell"; q-grid size and k-grid are not stated per material, so they are not counted
cost_units.lookup_note: J1-J3 read precomputed JARVIS-DFT values (cost 0 in this pipeline; their own DFT cost is sunk)

inconsistencies.what: Tc comparator: ">= 5 K" (abstract, Fig. 1) vs "> 5 K" (Sec 2.1)
gate order: Fig. 1 Tc (283) then stability (105); text stability (626) and Tc (105)
JARVIS-DFT size 55645 (Sec 1) vs 55723 materials with DOS (Sec 2.1, Fig. 1)
1736 -> 1058 mixes the <= 5 atoms gate with "as of now" incompleteness
